sloka: अभिपूज्य तदा हृष्टाः सर्वे चक्रुः यथा विधि ।प्रातः सवन पूर्वाणि कर्माणि मुनिपुंगवाः ॥१-१४-५॥
transliteration: abhipūjya tadā hṛṣṭāḥ sarve cakruḥ yathā vidhi ।prātaḥ savana pūrvāṇi karmāṇi munipuṁgavāḥ ॥1-14-5॥

translations.english: Thereafter the eminent ascetics, rejoicing in their hearts performed the worship (of celestial beings) and conducted the prescribed rituals starting with morning ablutions etc.
